result.details:
Method: fetched origin/feature/binary-config-serve-20260930, made a disposable detached clone at /tmp/rv-cfg and verified git rev-parse HEAD = d428e0f730ed5649485732e95d39c32f5d6a8895. src/settings/load.ts (897 lines) is entirely new in this branch, so the whole file was reviewed, not just the delta. Bun 1.4.2 was installed under /tmp/bun142 because the snapshot ships 1.3.14, which cannot read lockfileVersion 2; the lockfile was never rewritten.

F1 MEDIUM src/settings/load.ts:583-589. envValue() enters the quote branch when entry[0] is a quote and requires the trimmed value to END with that quote char; nothing strips a trailing comment after a closing quote, so 'export FREESTYLE_API_TOKEN="sample-literal-value"   # trailing comment' fails with env_file_invalid 'unterminated quote'. docs/CONFIGURATION.md:153 documents precisely that line. Consequence: a copy-pasteable documented input aborts startup; fails closed, no wrong value used. The same branch is also lenient the other way: KEY="a"b" is accepted as a"b. Not caught because tests/settings.test.ts:692 puts its only trailing comment on an unquoted value and line 728 covers a genuinely unterminated quote. Fix: locate the first unescaped closing quote, allow only whitespace or a '#' comment after it, fail with a distinct 'trailing content after quoted value' reason, and cover both cases.

F2 LOW src/settings/load.ts:588 and :601. unescapeDouble runs after expand, and expand uses a (?<!\\) lookbehind, so a literal double backslash before ${NAME} blocks expansion: value becomes the literal a\${BASE}b instead of a\<resolved>b, while docs:165 lists '\\' as a recognized escape. Fix with a single left-to-right pass so a backslash consumes the next character before '$' is examined.

F3 LOW src/settings/load.ts:751. prepare() checks document?.env_file !== undefined, so env_file = "" anchors to the config directory and readFile returns EISDIR; the diagnostic names a directory, not the file. Empty-means-unset is applied everywhere else (setValue line 662) and documented at docs:51. Fix with a non-empty/trimmed guard.

F4 LOW src/settings/load.ts:83 vs src/config.ts:81. client.token is kind 'text' with no bound and resolveClientSettings bypasses loadConfig, so a one-character client bearer token is accepted and sent, while server api_token requires >=24 chars. Fix by validating the client token with the same bound or documenting the exemption.

Verified sound: unknown top-level/nested/subtable keys, missing/2/"1" schema_version, duplicate key and duplicate table, TOML syntax errors, bare-scalar and empty documents, __proto__ and constructor keys, and wrong value types are all rejected with config_invalid; all 40 Config keys map 1:1 to config-file paths; 10 credential-canary probes (line-start key, inline table, multi-line string, quoted value containing ' #', bad client scheme) produced no canary in error.message or error.path; CRLF, UTF-8 BOM, unknown-name literals, forward references and inert $(...)/backticks behave as documented; a 128000-space line resolved in ~1 ms.

Limitations: src/serve.ts, src/serve-command.ts and lifecycle code were not assessed; tests/commands.test.ts, tests/serve.test.ts and tests/packaging.test.ts were skimmed for coverage only. Reviewer experiments live only in /tmp/rv-cfg and /tmp/probes, use fake providers and bounded local probes, and made no cloud/model/infrastructure calls; no real credentials appear in any artifact.
